mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2% over a 12-month horizon signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below 2% and remains below for 3 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: In at least 60% of triggered instances, 20-day forward returns are positive despite GDP growth below 2% for 3 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 3% signals a supply-side expansion that boosts corporate profit margins and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above 3% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% over a 6-month horizon signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% and remains above for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: In at least 70% of triggered instances, 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS above 4.5% for 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% over a 6-month horizon signals a tight labor market that drives wage inflation and input cost pressures, reducing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 3.5% and remains below for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tight labor market periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below 1.2 million units over a 6-month horizon signals a weakening residential construction sector that reduces consumer spending and economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1.2 million and remains below for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: In at least 60% of triggered instances, 60-day forward returns are positive despite HOUST below 1.2 million for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 6% over a 6-month horizon signals persistent inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to accelerate interest rate hikes, increasing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 6% and remains above for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: In at least 70% of triggered instances, 20-day forward returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL above 6% for 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below $650 billion over a 3-month horizon signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below $650 billion and remains below for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in consumer spending contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over a 6-month horizon signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% and remains above for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: In at least 60% of triggered instances, 60-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE above 4.5% for 6 months.
